questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

She gave me __________ antique bed cover.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**an**" before the term "**antique bed cover**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an antique bed cover**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She gave me **an antique bed cover**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "an" **– This part of the sentence is** grammatically correct **and should be used before a word starting with a vowel sound.
 
• **2: "a" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect because it should be used before a word starting with a consonant sound.
 
• **3: "enough" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect because it does not fit the context.
 
• **4: "than" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect because it does not fit the context.

• **Option 3: "is here"** – "Is" is singular and does not match the plural subject "They."
 
• **Option 4: "being here"** – This does not fit grammatically or contextually within the sentence.
 
• **No improvement** – This option is correct as the sentence is already correct.
